answer_1.quote: BARThez is particularly well-suited for generative tasks. We evaluate BARThez on five sentiment analysis, paraphrase identification, and natural language inference tasks from the recent FLUE benchmark, and two generative tasks from a novel French summarization dataset, OrangeSum...

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-1-2-L scores (Lin, 2004) and BERTScore scores...

answer_4.quote: To validate our positive quantitative results, we conducted a human evaluation study with 11 French native speakers...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were presented with two summaries and the input document and asked to decide which one was better based on accuracy (does the summary contain accurate facts?), informativeness (is important information captured?), and fluency (is the summary written in well-formed French?).
